title: Building relationships with customers through support didn't turn out as hoped
summary: This article discusses the author's unsuccessful experience using customer support as a tool to build relationships with users, sharing lessons learned from a podcast app called Castro. It's a candid retrospective on why direct customer support interactions failed to achieve the relationship-building goals they had hoped for.
problem_solved: Addresses the misconception that personal customer support interactions can effectively replace broader community-building and product improvements.
why_valuable: Provides honest insights into what doesn't work in customer relationships, helping other founders avoid similar missteps with their own products.
